A1.justification: Both PDFs describe TVQ&RAP. Their main text, equations, tables, figures, and complete appendices are readable and support reliable comparison, including matching repeated and renumbered material.

before.justification: v1 reports original super-resolution experiments, efficiency measurements, ablations, qualitative reconstructions, and a 15-participant user study in Appendix F.

after.justification: v3 retains those empirical results and adds original clustering and covariance analyses of VQ and TVQ latent features in Appendix H.

M1.justification: The structure/texture decomposition, texture codebook, losses, and straight-through-estimator prediction procedure remain unchanged in Section 3 and Appendix B. Section 4.4 repeats previously documented resolution choices rather than introducing a method modification.

E1.justification: Both versions use ImageNet training and ImageNet-Test, RealSR, RealSet65, and DRealSR evaluation coverage. The new latent-feature analysis identifies no additional dataset, application task, or input scenario.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in the matched benchmark, efficiency, and user-study comparisons. SeeSR and VARSR were already evaluated in v1 Appendix C. The new Appendix H reuses the existing vanilla VQ control.

E3.justification: Appendix H introduces a diagnostic protocol using matched k-means cluster counts of 64, 128, 256, and 512, nearest-center squared-distance distortion, and covariance-based measures of latent compactness. Previously reported training budgets, benchmark settings, and user-study procedures remain unchanged.

E4.justification: v3 adds two focused analyses testing whether TVQ features are easier to cluster and occupy a more compact distribution. Existing codebook, prediction-supervision, resolution, and feature-decoding analyses remain. Section 4.4 reproduces v1 Appendix E's resolution study and is not a new ablation.

E5.justification: Appendix H newly estimates empirical latent covariance and reports its trace and diagonally regularized log-determinant in Table 12. This adds descriptive statistical estimation, not repeated-run uncertainty: neither version reports seeds, confidence intervals, or formal significance tests.

E6.justification: New Table 11 reports VQ/TVQ clustering distortion, including 9.55/6.08 at K=512, a reported 36.4% reduction. Table 12 adds total variances of 32.4/21.6 and log-determinants of -63.7/-111. These are newly reported diagnostics; matched SR scores, efficiency results, user preferences, and qualitative examples are unchanged.

T1.justification: Equations (1)-(9) and the method's mathematical reasoning remain unchanged. Appendix H applies standard clustering and covariance diagnostics without adding a new formal model, theorem, proof, or substantive derivation.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions: texture-focused quantization, reconstruction-aware prediction, and efficient photorealistic super-resolution. Appendix H supplies additional support without redefining these core claims.

C2.justification: Appendix H interprets lower clustering distortion and covariance volume as direct evidence of a simpler, less redundant texture-feature distribution. This extends v1's mechanism discussion, which relied on reconstruction performance and qualitative feature decomposition, with interpretations of the new diagnostics.

D1.justification: v3 adds a reproducibility statement promising implementation and trained checkpoints, and changes the project-page organization from LabShuHangGU to CVL-UESTC. The PDFs do not establish that the promised resources are available. Existing architecture and training disclosures remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The reference lists contain the same works, and the positioning relative to dictionary learning, VQ methods, and generative SR remains unchanged. Repeating the resolution discussion introduces no new cited work.

P1.justification: v3 inserts Appendix H, repeats Appendix E as Section 4.4, adds a reproducibility statement, and repeats the existing LLM disclosure in the main text. It also updates the publication header and corrects Xinyu Zhou to Xingyu Zhou. Most existing prose and organization remain intact.

P2.justification: v3 adds Tables 11-12 and redisplays v1 Table 8 as main-text Table 6 while retaining it as Appendix Table 9. Table 2 corrects the PSNR/SSIM arrows from downward to upward. Figures 1-14 retain their content, with limited layout shifts and table renumbering.

improvement.justification: Appendix H modestly strengthens the evidence for the texture-codebook rationale beyond v1's reconstruction results and qualitative decomposition. Correcting Table 2's metric directions also improves clarity. These gains are limited by missing feature-sampling and regularization details in the new analysis and unnecessary duplication of the resolution discussion and table between Section 4.4 and Appendix E.
